probe.baseline_value: turn_on (step 5 and step 6 of a plan heating only in steps 4-7); turn_off (step 10 of a plan heating only in step 0)
probe.run_from: a scratch baseline worktree at 92d38ecb (never the gate tree while a gate runs); thread_factor 1.000

should_fail.check_area: dst_checks.py _pump_command ('the pump walks the plan by TRUE elapsed steps across the fold' / 'and that agreement is the OFF the true index commands'); features.py coordinator pump glue (features.py:20356-20410) and the T5 _async_drive_pumps block (features.py:55432-)
should_fail.why_it_passes: dst_checks drives the space pump with a plan ON only in steps 4-7 and reads it 2 h in (step 8: OFF) -- step 0 is OFF too, so an index stuck at 0 commands the same OFF; the features.py glue checks drive only the VVC pump or assert transitions/caching, never which plan step the space pump follows
should_fail.assertion_it_lacks: a space-pump tick with `now` inside a plan step whose heat differs from step 0 (e.g. heat only in steps 4-7, tick at 1.25 h) asserting turn_on (and the mirror: heat only in step 0, tick at 2.5 h, asserting turn_off)

finding.title: No check fails when the space pump stops walking the plan: its step index can stay at step 0 (coordinator.py:4525)
finding.claim: With coordinator.py:4525 `if result.timestamps:` disabled, _async_drive_pumps commands the space circulation pump from the plan's first step instead of the current one -- turn_off at 1.25 h into a plan that heats in steps 4-7 (baseline turn_on) -- and the full GATE_SCOPE=full gate stays green beyond its null.
finding.metric_definition: the homeassistant service (turn_on/turn_off) _async_drive_pumps issues for the configured space pump at a tick 1.25 h into a quarter-grid plan heating only in steps 4-7

perturbation.change: coordinator.py:4525 `if result.timestamps:` -> `if False:` (in memory in the probe; on disk in the gate)
perturbation.expected_direction: turn_on -> turn_off at step 5 and 6; turn_off -> turn_on at step 10 of a step-0-only plan

finding.mechanism: idx defaults to 0 and is only advanced inside the timestamps branch; the suite's only space-pump plan walk (dst_checks.py) reads a step that is OFF exactly like step 0
finding.phenomenon_property: every guard/branch of this function changes an observable output on some reachable input, and the suite asserts that output on that input
finding.seam_rule: awk -F'\t' '$6=="gate"' SURVIVORS.tsv (the wave list) restricted to the function's cluster; each SURVIVED key is a seam
finding.proposed_fix_scope: tests only: add the missing assertion to the named closure script; no production change
